description:
Download the raw bytes of a file attachment of an Outlook message in the signed-in user's mailbox, by message ID and attachment ID.

💡 TIP: Find the attachment id with list-mail-attachments first. With the server's blob output on, the bytes come back as a file resource; pass fileName (the attachment's name) to name it. Files over the server's download limit are refused with an error naming the limit.

attachmentId.description: Value for the 'attachmentId' path segment. Pass it under the name 'attachmentId', not as 'id'. Use the 'id' field of the attachment object as returned by Microsoft Graph.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure indication

fetchAllPages.description: Follow @odata.nextLink and merge up to 100 pages into one response. Can return enormous payloads—only when the user explicitly needs a full export. Prefer a small $top first, then paginate or narrow with $filter/$search.

fileName.description: Name of the file, used as the last segment of the returned resource URI when the server runs with blob output. Optional.

includeHeaders.description: Include response headers (including ETag) in the response metadata

messageId.description: Value for the 'messageId' path segment. Pass it under the name 'messageId', not as 'id'. Use the 'id' field of the message object as returned by Microsoft Graph.

name: get-mail-attachment-content
title: get-mail-attachment-content
